name: Context-aware Mathematical Expression Recognition Benchmark
description: Evaluates end-to-end recognition accuracy of mathematical expressions in images, leveraging contextual cues to produce structured outputs (e.g., LaTeX or expression trees).
reputation: Well-cited within the mathematical OCR / expression recognition community but primarily used in specialized research rather than broad ML benchmarks.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on image-to-structure OCR; datasets tend to be domain-specific and relatively small compared to large-scale vision corpora, and performance is sensitive to symbol-level variations and rendering styles.
